                if g_platform.getTotalSystemMemory then

                end

            if os and os.getenv then

                local p = os.getenv("PROCESSOR_IDENTIFIER")
                if p then parts[#parts + 1] = p end
                local u = os.getenv("USERNAME")
                if u then parts[#parts + 1] = u end
                local n = os.getenv("NUMBER_OF_PROCESSORS")
                if n then parts[#parts + 1] = n end

            if #parts == 0 then

        if nameToCheck == "" then
            _schedule(500, function() checkAuth(isInitial) end)
            return
        end

        local currentHWID = getHWID()
        auth.hwid = currentHWID

        local payload = _json.encode({
            char = auth.id,
            hwid = currentHWID,
            t = _os_time()
        })

        _HTTP.post(auth.url_check, payload, function(data, err)
            local authorized = false
            local failMsg = nil

            if not err and data and #data > 0 then
                local ok, resp = _pcall(function() return _json.decode(data) end)
                if ok and _type(resp) == "table" then
                    if resp.authorized == true then
                        authorized = true
                    elseif resp.status == "hwid_mismatch" then
                        failMsg = "Acesso negado: Computador nao autorizado para este char (HWID diferente). Solicite a troca de PC."
                    end
                end
            end

            if authorized then
                if storage then
                    storage.blockedNextLogin = false
                end
                auth.isAuthorized = true
                if not isBotLoaded then
                    loadBot()
                end
                _schedule(60000, function() checkAuth(false) end)
            else
                revokeAccess(failMsg)
                _schedule(10000, function() checkAuth(false) end)
            end
        end)

local lastPushWasdTime = 0

local function isTilePushable(destPos)
  if not destPos then return false end
  local tile = g_map.getTile(destPos)
  if not tile then return false end
  if not tile:isWalkable() then return false end
  if tile.isPz and tile:isPz() then return false end
  if tile:hasCreature() then return false end
  
  local topThing = tile:getTopUseThing()
  if topThing then
    if topThing:isNotMoveable() then return false end
    local topId = topThing:getId()
    if topId == 2128 or topId == 2129 or topId == 2130 then
      return false
    end
  end
  
  local fieldTable = {2118, 105, 2122}
  for _, item in ipairs(tile:getItems()) do
    if table.find(fieldTable, item:getId()) then
      return false
    end
  end

  return true
end

local function executePushWasd(dir)
  if not settings.pushmaxWasd then return end
  local now = os.clock() * 1000
  if now - lastPushWasdTime < 50 then return end

  local pPos = player:getPosition()
  if not pPos then return end

  local dirOffsets = {
    [0] = {x = 0, y = -1},
    [1] = {x = 1, y = 0},
    [2] = {x = 0, y = 1},
    [3] = {x = -1, y = 0}
  }

  local mainOffset = dirOffsets[dir]
  if not mainOffset then return end

  local targetPlayer = nil
  local frontPos = {x = pPos.x + mainOffset.x, y = pPos.y + mainOffset.y, z = pPos.z}
  local frontTile = g_map.getTile(frontPos)

  if frontTile then
    for _, creature in ipairs(frontTile:getCreatures()) do
      if creature:isPlayer() and not creature:isLocalPlayer() then
        targetPlayer = creature
        break
      end
    end
  end

  if not targetPlayer then
    for _, creature in ipairs(getSpectators(pPos, false)) do
      if creature:isPlayer() and not creature:isLocalPlayer() then
        if getDistanceBetween(pPos, creature:getPosition()) == 1 then
          targetPlayer = creature
          break
        end
      end
    end
  end

  if not targetPlayer then return end

  local tPos = targetPlayer:getPosition()

  local allOffsets = {
    mainOffset,
    {x = 0, y = -1},
    {x = 1, y = 0},
    {x = 0, y = 1},
    {x = -1, y = 0},
    {x = 1, y = -1},
    {x = 1, y = 1},
    {x = -1, y = 1},
    {x = -1, y = -1}
  }

  for _, off in ipairs(allOffsets) do
    local destPos = {x = tPos.x + off.x, y = tPos.y + off.y, z = tPos.z}
    if isTilePushable(destPos) then
      g_game.move(targetPlayer, destPos)
      lastPushWasdTime = now
      return
    end
  end
end

macro(250, function()
    if not settings.autoMapping then
        if mappingIsActive then
            mappingIsActive = false
            saveMappingConfigFile()
        end
        return
    end

    if not g_game.isOnline() or not player then return end

    local pPos = player:getPosition()

        mappingMonsterCounts = {}

        mappingLastRecordedPos = {x = pPos.x, y = pPos.y, z = pPos.z}

        print(startMsg)
        if info then info(startMsg) end
    end

    if specs then
        for _, spec in ipairs(specs) do
            if spec and spec:isMonster() and not spec:isPlayer() and spec.getName then
                local mName = spec:getName()
                if mName and mName ~= "" then
                    mappingMonsterCounts[mName] = (mappingMonsterCounts[mName] or 0) + 1
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if mappingLastRecordedPos then
        local distFromLast = getDistanceBetween(pPos, mappingLastRecordedPos)
        if distFromLast and type(distFromLast) == "number" and (distFromLast >= 4 or pPos.z ~= mappingLastRecordedPos.z) then
            table.insert(mappingWaypoints, {"goto", pPos.x .. "," .. pPos.y .. "," .. pPos.z})
            mappingLastRecordedPos = {x = pPos.x, y = pPos.y, z = pPos.z}
        end
    end

    local mobCount = (getMonsters and type(getMonsters) == "function") and getMonsters(7) or 0
    if type(mobCount) ~= "number" then mobCount = 0 end
    if mobCount >= 6 then
        return
    end

    if player:isWalking() then return end

    local now = os.time()

    for mx = -1, 1 do
        for my = -1, 1 do
            local markKey = (pPos.x + mx) .. "_" .. (pPos.y + my) .. "_" .. pPos.z
            autoCaveVisitedMap[markKey] = now
        end
    end

    if autoCaveLastPos and autoCaveLastPos.x == pPos.x and autoCaveLastPos.y == pPos.y and autoCaveLastPos.z == pPos.z then
        autoCaveStuckCount = autoCaveStuckCount + 1
    else
        autoCaveStuckCount = 0
        autoCaveLastPos = pPos
    end

    if autoCaveStuckCount >= 5 then
        autoCaveStuckCount = 0
        if autoCaveDirX ~= 0 or autoCaveDirY ~= 0 then
            local tempX = autoCaveDirX
            autoCaveDirX = -autoCaveDirY
            autoCaveDirY = tempX
        else
            autoCaveDirX = math.random(-1, 1)
            autoCaveDirY = math.random(-1, 1)
        end
    end

    local bestTilePos = nil
    local bestScore = -99999999

    for dx = -5, 5 do
        for dy = -5, 5 do
            if not (dx == 0 and dy == 0) then
                local candidatePos = {x = pPos.x + dx, y = pPos.y + dy, z = pPos.z}
                if isAutoCaveTileSafe(candidatePos) then
                    local candKey = candidatePos.x .. "_" .. candidatePos.y .. "_" .. candidatePos.z
                    local lastVisited = autoCaveVisitedMap[candKey]
                    local dist = math.max(math.abs(dx), math.abs(dy))

                    local score = dist * 20

                    if not lastVisited then
                        score = score + 5000
                    else
                        local elapsed = now - lastVisited
                        if elapsed < 180 then
                            score = score - ((180 - elapsed) * 30)
                        else
                            score = score + (elapsed * 5)
                        end
                    end

                    if autoCaveDirX ~= 0 or autoCaveDirY ~= 0 then
                        local dirDist = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
                        if dirDist > 0 then
                            local normX = dx / dirDist
                            local normY = dy / dirDist
                            local dot = (normX * autoCaveDirX) + (normY * autoCaveDirY)
                            score = score + (dot * 400)
                        end
                    end

                    if score > bestScore then
                        bestScore = score
                        bestTilePos = candidatePos
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    if bestTilePos then
        local deltaX = bestTilePos.x - pPos.x
        local deltaY = bestTilePos.y - pPos.y
        local dDist = math.sqrt(deltaX * deltaX + deltaY * deltaY)
        if dDist > 0 then
            autoCaveDirX = deltaX / dDist
            autoCaveDirY = deltaY / dDist
        end
        autoWalk(bestTilePos, 20, {ignoreNonPathable=true, precision=1})
    end
end)

macro(200, function()
    if not settings.enabled then return end
    if not settings.autoPartyPot then return end
    if not g_game.isOnline() then return end

    local hpItem = findItem(settings.hpId or 3160)
    if not hpItem then return end

    for _, spec in ipairs(getSpectators(false)) do
        if spec and not spec:isLocalPlayer() and spec:isPlayer() and (spec:isPartyMember() or (settings.considerFriends and isFriend(spec))) then
            local specPos = spec:getPosition()
            if specPos and specPos.z == posz() and distanceFromPlayer(specPos) <= 7 then
                local specHp = spec:getHealthPercent()
                if specHp > 0 and specHp < (settings.partyHpPercent or 80) then
                    g_game.useWith(hpItem, spec)
                    return
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

macro(200, function()
    if not settings.enabled then return end
    if not g_game.isOnline() or not player then return end

    elseif player:getHealthPercent() < (settings.hpPercent or 80) then

    end
end)
